title: SKE Bar Watermelon Ice Prefilled Vape Pod
description: This Watermelon Ice pod for the SKE Bar Prefilled Pod Kit serves up a fresh, delicately sweet fruit flavour with a brisk, menthol twist. Expect bright Watermelon with a clean, cooling finish ideal for vapers who enjoy refreshing profiles with light fruity notes. Each pod is prefilled with 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt and features mesh coil tech for consistent flavour and vapour performance. Please Note: These are pods ONLY and the Battery is not included.
